constraints: All database access must go through repository interfaces (GP-001) — this phase defines those interfaces
No inline SQL/ORM calls in route handlers or business logic — repository pattern enforced
Strict TypeScript: no implicit any, strict null checks — all interface fields must be explicitly typed
Modules import from each other ONLY through declared public entry points (index.ts) — not applicable this phase since no cross-module imports
outOfScope: Balance routes and Fastify registration (Phase 6, Phase 7)
Audit logging (GP-002) — no state-changing operations in this phase
RBAC enforcement (GP-005) — no API endpoints in this phase
Business rule enforcement (BR-001 through BR-012) — service layer responsibility in Phase 4

FAILED status on BalanceAdjustment — ARCHITECTURE.md mentions it but Phase 1 intent explicitly lists only PENDING, APPLIED, REVERSED

ambiguities.description: remainingDays is listed as a field in the LeaveBalance interface but described as "derived as totalEntitlement - usedDays." TypeScript interfaces cannot enforce derivation — the field will be a regular property. The unit test verifies the formula, so the code-agent should treat it as a plain field whose value is computed by consumers (or by a factory/constructor in later phases).
options: Include remainingDays as a regular field in the interface; consumers are responsible for computing it correctly
Omit remainingDays from the interface and provide a helper function getRemainingDays(balance) instead
Define remainingDays as a readonly field and document that it must equal totalEntitlement - usedDays

ambiguities.description: Numeric field types (totalEntitlement, usedDays, amountDays, fiscalYear) are not explicitly typed in the intent. The Phase 2 migration uses decimal for entitlement/days and integer for fiscalYear. The code-agent must infer TypeScript types: likely number for all.
options: Use number for all numeric fields
Use number for fiscalYear and amountDays, but string for decimal fields to match PostgreSQL decimal
Match the migration types exactly: number for fiscalYear (integer), number for decimal fields
